about: One hour of shadow reporting: what answer engines told a reader, split into checkable statements in our own words and compared with this site's record. An engine's answer is evidence about the engine, not about the storm. The answers' full text is not here (raw store, outside git: the pointer and sha256 are).

answers.question: charles-lisbon
answers.engine_name: OpenAI GPT-5 mini with web search

statements.text: IPMA has downgraded wind warnings for Lisbon to orange while keeping the rain warnings
statements.note: the first answer in three rounds to carry the 07:16 change, seven hours on, from a news agency's English service

statements.text: Gusts around 100 to 120 km/h in exposed spots
statements.note: 90, up to 110 km/h since 12:33

statements.text: Very rough seas along the Lisbon and Setúbal coast
Nothing on communiqué no. 3 or on the rain warning ending at 15:00
statements.note: an omission

answers.told: Yes, affecting Portugal today; the strongest winds a little weaker than feared; IPMA lowered some wind warnings for Lisbon to orange, rain alerts kept.

answers.question: charles-lisbon

statements.text: Red warnings in force for the district; airport disruption
The centre may pass south of Lisbon, between Sines and Cabo Carvoeiro; the track is still uncertain
statements.note: answered as a forecast at 14:07, with the storm over Lisbon (991 hPa and falling at 13:00) and IPMA's communiqué no. 3 two hours old

statements.text: A possible sting jet, gusts up to about 150 to 160 km/h in the broader alert area
statements.note: Tuesday's worst case, one of the cited pages dated today; IPMA's text for Lisbon since 12:33: up to 90 km/h, 110 exposed

answers.told: Yes, very likely affected; red warnings in force; the centre may pass south; a possible sting jet with gusts of 150 to 160 km/h in the wider area.

statements.text: The latest updates: less impact in Lisbon than first forecast, more toward the Alentejo and the Algarve; civil protection admits a smaller impact

answers.told: Yes, among the zones that may be affected; less impact in Lisbon than first forecast; red warning with gusts of 120 to 140 km/h "in several forecasts".

websummit-tomorrow.text: Web Summit's own page (Tuesday 19:09): Day 2 off, Day 3 "aims to proceed". The press since about 12:00 Wednesday: the organisers confirmed Thursday in a message to participants (not read by us at the organisers' page).

lisbon-warnings.text: IPMA (messages of 12:33): in force at 14:07 in the Lisbon district: red rain to 15:00 (then yellow to 18:00), orange wind to 18:00 (gusts up to 90 km/h, 110 exposed), orange sea to 21:00. The alert situation to 23:59.

charles-lisbon.text: IPMA's communiqué no. 3 (12:16): the low split into two centres, weaker wind than forecast, persistent rain. Observed at 13:00: heavy rain, 991 hPa and falling at the airport; 57.7 mm in six hours at one IPMA station in Lisbon.

metro.text: The mayor (Tuesday): the Metro runs on Wednesday. At 11:52 the Metro's own site carried no service notice.

madeira.text: IPMA: red warnings ended 06:00; Areeiro 249.5 mm in six hours, 474.7 in twelve. Regional civil protection, as relayed by Lusa: 285 occurrences up to about 13:00. ANA at 11:00: 20 of 80 flights cancelled in advance.
